about: Three disco loops for the app, one per disco level. Made with the open model ACE-Step 1.5 XL Turbo from a style description only (no song, band or artist named, no recording used). Made by tools/media/make_music.py from tools/media/music.json.

model.licenseNote: ACE-Step weights: MIT. The text encoder inside the same repository (Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B) is Apache-2.0. The model card says the generated music may be used commercially.

tracks.name: groove
tracks.prompt: 1970s disco instrumental, tight and steady dance-floor groove, four-on-the-floor kick drum, crisp open hi-hats on the off-beats, funky octave-jumping electric bass line, choppy wah-wah rhythm guitar, clavinet, handclaps on two and four, warm analog studio recording, live band feel, no vocals

tracks.name: bigger
tracks.prompt: 1970s disco instrumental, big and bright dance-floor groove, four-on-the-floor kick drum, open hi-hats on the off-beats, funky octave-jumping electric bass line, wah-wah rhythm guitar, clavinet, lush orchestral string section, punchy brass section stabs, handclaps, warm analog studio recording, live band feel, no vocals

tracks.name: full-on
tracks.prompt: 1970s disco instrumental at full peak energy, everything playing at once, driving four-on-the-floor kick drum, busy open hi-hats, funky octave-jumping electric bass line, wah-wah rhythm guitar, clavinet, soaring orchestral strings, loud brass section stabs, congas, bongos, cowbell, tambourine, shakers and timbales, extra percussion everywhere, euphoric and busy, warm analog studio recording, live band feel, no vocals
